        "All 97 owned diff lines and the complete historical and accepted 120-line deletion modules were read. The constant caps each request at 1000 IDs. The primary records a Microsoft 365 server error and explicitly leaves configurability and other servers uncertain. The observed limit is not a universal Exchange or protocol requirement.",
        "The operation builds ItemId values without change keys, visits item_ids.chunks(1000), copies each block for HardDelete, then awaits enqueue_and_send before the next block. It checks response count against that block and pairs results with its IDs. ErrorItemNotFound is ignored; another processing error stops later blocks. This function does not compensate prior successful requests. Empty input now makes no requests and returns success, unlike the previous single empty request; that edge was not tested here.",
        "The accepted module later narrows method visibility and renames the listener type. Its checked shared handle_operation awaits the whole operation before success/error dispatch. Success carries no item IDs and disables legacy fallback. That bounded listener dispatch is not proof of native folder-state updates or complete error UI. No owned tests or assertions change.",
        "The full primary and creation-to-final own review were read, with no actual inline or summary-history bodies. Reviewer suggests chunks; author reports adopting it and actual source confirms chunks plus block copying. Reviewer qualifies copying as suitable for IDs rather than whole messages. This is documentation, with no owned tests or live command/accessibility run.",
        "The exact accepted implementation first asks top.document.commandDispatcher for a supporting controller and checks its enabled state. If needed it separately scans top.controllers, skips that first object and requires support plus enabled. The source expressly says the sets differ. goDoCommand unwraps wrappedJSObject when present and forwards arguments. This bounded algorithm is more precise than either a blanket focus-first description or a universal DOM-walk rule; the upstream dispatcher implementation was not followed.",

The actual compact-folder toolbar consumer uses the helper for disabled state and goDoCommand after a current-about3Pane guard; no claim is made about every tab handler.",

        "All 186 owned diff lines across the JS sender, native listener and account-key test were read. The native path was classified from directives first; its changed hunks and retained current window lie outside the sole #ifndef MOZ_SUITE block. No excluded Suite body is used.",
        "_deliverMessage now awaits _deliverAsNews. The news transport creates a dedicated listener, chooses the progress/topmost message window, posts and awaits requestPromise. The listener unregisters from an actual mail/news URL, awaits sendDeliveryCallback and only then settles by exit status. If that awaited callback rejects, the subsequent resolve/reject statements are not reached; this is a static conditional boundary, not an executed hang or a claim that every cleanup completes. The bounded sendDeliveryCallback maps nonabort news errors to failure before delivery-exit processing.",

The closing branch notifies ComposeProcessDone, closes/unregisters progress and later notifies the send listener. Accepted code additionally releases compose keepalive only when that phase is done; that later detail is not projected into the original patch. The complete downstream window/error-processing pipeline was not traced.",
